title: Tech Note: Adding a Styles Palette to 4D Write

historical_commentary.text: 4D Write (the classic plug-in) has been superseded by 4D Write Pro, which provides a modern word processing component with built-in style management, CSS-like styling, and a comprehensive toolbar. The manual palette-building approach described here—creating buttons for each style and managing help tips dynamically—is no longer necessary. 4D Write Pro's built-in widget bar and programmatic style commands provide far more sophisticated style management out of the box.
